card.name: Opening bracket before units in table headers
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or bracket (and sometimes the word "in") right before a unit such as kg, mg/dL or mL. It appears in dosing-table column headers like "Patient weight (kg)".

modes.label: Bracket before weight unit
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or bracket after a column title like Patient weight or Body Weight, just before kg.
modes.example: Infusion Rates for Epoprostenol for Injection at a Concentration of 30,000 ng/mL Patient weight<< (>>kg) Dose or Drug Delivery Rate

modes.label: Bracket before lab unit
modes.description: Opening parenthesis after a lab value range, just before a unit like mg/dL.
modes.example: Fasting triglycerides Normal to High <150 to ≥200<< (>>mg/dL) (n/N *

card.writes: It suppresses "early" words, which seems unrelated; there is no clear link to the unit that follows.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a unit of measure like kg is about to be written in a table heading.
